advancement_rule: Advance to ECG with a practical accuracy gain supported by loss/stability. If negligible or negative at40, preserve the outcome and investigate mechanisms rather than extending past the repository budget or forcing complementarity.
estimated_additional_cost: 30additional epochs at~93seconds per arm plus restart/validation overhead; approximately95minutes for both arms, estimated.
hypothesis: Resolve whether FIR+gain yields a practical SSC unseen-speaker validation improvement beyond the preliminary+0.23pp.
initialization: Full resume of own last checkpoint; exact training provenance retained.
matched_control: Same fresh-started Baseline/A runs, each fully resumed after10epochs; full40epoch schedule unchanged.
resume_randomness_caveat: Full resume restores own weights/optimizer/scheduler/globalstep/epoch, but does not establish identical dropout/data-order randomness to uninterrupted training. Both matched arms pause after10.
